paragraphs.text: translated by
1. I HAVE enriched the singer with surpassing wealth; I have allowed the holy hymn to strengthen me.
paragraphs.original: अहं दां गृणते पूर्व्यं वस्वहं ब्रह्म कृणवं मह्यं वर्धनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ dāṃ gṛṇate pūrvyaṃ vasvahaṃ brahma kṛṇavaṃ mahyaṃ vardhanam |

paragraphs.text: I, furtherer of him who offers sacrifice, have conquered in each fight the men who worship not.
paragraphs.original: अहं भुवं यजमानस्य चोदितायज्वनः साक्षि विश्वस्मिन्भरे
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ bhuvaṃ yajamānasya coditāyajvanaḥ sākṣi viśvasminbhare

paragraphs.text: 2. The People of the heavens, the waters, and the earth have stablished me among the Gods with Indra's name.
paragraphs.original: मां धुरिन्द्रं नाम देवता दिवश्च ग्मश्चापां च जन्तवः ।
paragraphs.translit: māṃ dhurindraṃ nāma devatā divaśca gmaścāpāṃ ca jantavaḥ |

paragraphs.text: I took unto myself the two swift vigorous Bays that speed on divers paths, and the fierce bolt for strength.
paragraphs.original: अहं हरी वृषणा विव्रता रघू अहं वज्रं शवसे धृष्ण्वा ददे
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ harī vṛṣaṇā vivratā raghū ahaṃ vajraṃ śavase dhṛṣṇvā dade

paragraphs.text: 3. With deadly blows I smote Atka for Kavi's sake; I guarded Kutsa well with these saving helps.
paragraphs.original: अहमत्कं कवये शिश्नथं हथैरहं कुत्समावमाभिरूतिभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: ahamatkaṃ kavaye śiśnathaṃ hathairahaṃ kutsamāvamābhirūtibhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: As Susna's slayer I brandished the dart of death: I gave not up the Aryan name to Dasyu foes.
paragraphs.original: अहं शुष्णस्य श्नथिता वधर्यमं न यो रर आर्यं नाम दस्यवे
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ śuṣṇasya śnathitā vadharyamaṃ na yo rara āryaṃ nāma dasyave

paragraphs.text: 4. Smadibha, Tugra, and the Vetasus I gave as prey to Kutsa, father-like, to succour him.
paragraphs.original: अहं पितेव वेतसूँरभिष्टये तुग्रं कुत्साय स्मदिभं च रन्धयम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ piteva vetasūm̐rabhiṣṭaye tugraṃ kutsāya smadibhaṃ ca randhayam |

paragraphs.text: I was a worthy King to rule the worshipper, when I gave Tuji dear inviolable gifts.
paragraphs.original: अहं भुवं यजमानस्य राजनि प्र यद्भरे तुजये न प्रियाधृषे
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ bhuvaṃ yajamānasya rājani pra yadbhare tujaye na priyādhṛṣe

paragraphs.text: 5. I gave up Mrgaya to Srutarvan as his prey because he ever followed me and kept my laws.
paragraphs.original: अहं रन्धयं मृगयं श्रुतर्वणे यन्माजिहीत वयुना चनानुषक् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ randhayaṃ mṛgayaṃ śrutarvaṇe yanmājihīta vayunā canānuṣak |

paragraphs.text: For Ayu's sake I caused Veta to bend and bow, and into Savya's hand delivered Padgrbhi.
paragraphs.original: अहं वेशं नम्रमायवेऽकरमहं सव्याय पड्गृभिमरन्धयम्
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ veśaṃ namramāyave'karamahaṃ savyāya paḍgṛbhimarandhayam

paragraphs.text: 6. 1, I crushed Navavastva of the lofty car, the Dasa, as the Vrtra-slayer kills the fiends;
paragraphs.original: अहं स यो नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं सं वृत्रेव दासं वृत्रहारुजम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ sa yo navavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ saṃ vṛtreva dāsaṃ vṛtrahārujam |

paragraphs.text: When straightway on the region's farthest edge I brought the God who makes the lights to broaden and increase.
paragraphs.original: यद्वर्धयन्तं प्रथयन्तमानुषग्दूरे पारे रजसो रोचनाकरम्
paragraphs.translit: yadvardhayantaṃ prathayantamānuṣagdūre pāre rajaso rocanākaram

paragraphs.text: 7. I travel round about borne onward in my might by the fleet-footed dappled Horses of the Sun.
paragraphs.original: अहं सूर्यस्य परि याम्याशुभिः प्रैतशेभिर्वहमान ओजसा ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ sūryasya pari yāmyāśubhiḥ praitaśebhirvahamāna ojasā |

paragraphs.text: When man's libation calls me to the robe of state I soon repel the powerful Dasyu with my blows.
paragraphs.original: यन्मा सावो मनुष आह निर्णिज ऋधक्कृषे दासं कृत्व्यं हथैः
paragraphs.translit: yanmā sāvo manuṣa āha nirṇija ṛdhakkṛṣe dāsaṃ kṛtvyaṃ hathaiḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Stronger am I than Nabus, I who slew the seven: I glorified with might Yadu and Turvaga.
paragraphs.original: अहं सप्तहा नहुषो नहुष्टरः प्राश्रावयं शवसा तुर्वशं यदुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ saptahā nahuṣo nahuṣṭaraḥ prāśrāvayaṃ śavasā turvaśaṃ yadum |

paragraphs.text: I brought another low, with strength I bent his strength: I let the mighty nine-and-ninety wax in power.
paragraphs.original: अहं न्यन्यं सहसा सहस्करं नव व्राधतो नवतिं च वक्षयम्
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ nyanyaṃ sahasā sahaskaraṃ nava vrādhato navatiṃ ca vakṣayam

paragraphs.text: 9. Bull over all the streams that flow along the earth, I took the Seven Rivers as mine own domain.
paragraphs.original: अहं सप्त स्रवतो धारयं वृषा द्रवित्न्वः पृथिव्यां सीरा अधि ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ sapta sravato dhārayaṃ vṛṣā dravitnvaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sīrā adhi |

paragraphs.text: I, gifted with great wisdom, spread the floods abroad: by war I found for man the way to high success.
paragraphs.original: अहमर्णांसि वि तिरामि सुक्रतुर्युधा विदं मनवे गातुमिष्टये
paragraphs.translit: ahamarṇāṃsi vi tirāmi sukraturyudhā vidaṃ manave gātumiṣṭaye

paragraphs.text: 10. I set within these cows the white milk which no God, not even Tvastar's self, had there deposited,-
paragraphs.original: अहं तदासु धारयं यदासु न देवश्चन त्वष्टाधारयद्रुशत् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ tadāsu dhārayaṃ yadāsu na devaścana tvaṣṭādhārayadruśat |

paragraphs.text: Much-longed-for, in the breasts, the udders of the kine, the savoury sweets of meath, the milk and Soma juice.
paragraphs.original: स्पार्हं गवामूधस्सु वक्षणास्वा मधोर्मधु श्वात्र्यं सोममाशिरम्
paragraphs.translit: spārhaṃ gavāmūdhassu vakṣaṇāsvā madhormadhu śvātryaṃ somamāśiram

paragraphs.text: 11. Even thus hath Indra Maghavan, truly bounteous, sped Gods and men with mighty operation.
paragraphs.original: एवा देवाँ इन्द्रो विव्ये नॄन्प्र च्यौत्नेन मघवा सत्यराधाः ।
paragraphs.translit: evā devām̐ indro vivye nṝnpra cyautnena maghavā satyarādhāḥ |

paragraphs.text: The pious glorify all these thine exploits, Lord of Bay Coursers, Strong, and self resplendent.
paragraphs.original: विश्वेत्ता ते हरिवः शचीवोऽभि तुरासः स्वयशो गृणन्ति
paragraphs.translit: viśvettā te harivaḥ śacīvo'bhi turāsaḥ svayaśo gṛṇanti
